verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs say you can "launch prebuilt or custom templates with one click" and describe templates as the way to set up a rented machine with the software it needs. The docs homepage points to ready-made PyTorch, vLLM and ComfyUI deployments you can copy, and the CLI exposes templates. missing for 10: an explicit CUDA template, detail on the contents of the prebuilt template catalog (docs-27 may describe deployment guides rather than templates), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the templates work.
